subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Linear vs. Circular Models
description: A short lesson to help you apply Linear vs. Circular Models.

hook.text: Make it, use it, throw it away. That's the linear model. It created a planet drowning in waste.

buildup.text: Linear supply chains extract, produce, consume, and discard. Resources flow in one direction—to landfill.

discovery.text: Circular supply chains design waste out: products are reused, repaired, refurbished, or recycled.

twist.text: Circularity requires redesigning products for disassembly—something most current products weren't built for.

climax.text: The circular economy could generate $4.5 trillion in economic value by 2030, according to Accenture.

punchline.text: Waste is a design flaw. Circularity is the fix.

quiz.question: What is the core idea of a circular supply chain?
options: Design waste out by reusing, repairing, and recycling
